llm_outcome_maturity.rule: Never report an LLM win rate when no valid outcomes are mature. Never use general forward-cohort performance as the LLM's performance.

what_each_number_counts.57_observations: DECISION-level: unique forward decisions across 3 general-cohort generations (gen1=12 + gen2=22 + gen3=23). One per (symbol, decision_date). NOT strategy outcomes.
what_each_number_counts.43_matured: STRATEGY-OUTCOME level: 43 strategy outcomes reached a terminal exit (SL or TP3) within the scan window. Counted over (filled_decisions x 3 strategies). NOT 43 decisions and NOT horizon maturities.
what_each_number_counts.59_pending: STRATEGY-OUTCOME level: 59 strategy outcomes are still open (pending_mtm = marked-to-market, NEVER counted as a win). Counted over (filled_decisions x 3 strategies). NOT 59 decisions.

explanation_57_43_59.why_they_do_not_add_up_to_one_denominato: They use three different denominators. 57 counts DECISIONS (symbol x date). 43 and 59 count STRATEGY OUTCOMES (decision x strategy). The 34 filled decisions x 3 strategies = 102 strategy outcomes = 43 matured-terminal + 59 pending-mtm. The remaining 23 decisions (gen3) have no entry bar yet (awaiting_entry_bar) so contribute 0 strategy outcomes. 102 + 23 unfilled-decisions does NOT equal 57 because the denominators differ (decisions vs strategy-outcomes).

summary_block.note: MTM is hypothetical unrealized value, not evidence of edge

critical_clarifications: 43 'matured' are TERMINAL EARLY EXITS (SL/TP3), NOT 5/10/21-session horizon maturities. Zero horizon outcomes have matured for any cohort (earliest 21-session ~2026-12-01).
59 'pending' are open positions marked-to-market; MTM is NEVER counted as a win and does not appear in win-rate/expectancy.
The LLM cohort (task111-llm-multisource-gen1) is a SEPARATE cohort with 0 matured outcomes — it is never added to the 57/43/59.
The DB prospective layer (375 predictions, 114 paper trades) is yet another SEPARATE layer with 0 matured outcomes — never added to any forward total.
explanation_57_43_59.conclusion: No software bug and no missing records. The three figures refer to different cohorts/denominators and reconcile exactly within each. Adding them across cohorts would be double-counting and is forbidden.
